description: Two phone-only capabilities. Haptic feedback on the few moments where something is handed to you or taken away: a code copied, a file removed, a transfer finished, an offer answered, a mode swipe committed. There is no desktop equivalent, and the frontend gates every call on a coarse pointer and swallows failures. And the camera, for reading the QR another device is showing when adding a device; a refused camera is an ordinary state and leaves typing the code as a complete path.
